source_value.trigger: No product trigger is observable in this asset. Outside the presenter's circular webcam overlay at the lower left, the Mixpanel surface does not change at any point: sampled at 6 fps, the consecutive-frame mean absolute difference over the 31316 px outside that overlay stays between 0.000 and 0.021/255, and between 0.5s and 8.167s no pixel outside the overlay differs by more than 12/255.
source_value.start_state: media/state-01.png at 0.5s: the insight builder inside a browser window, a four-icon chart-type strip whose first icon sits in a filled light-lavender box, three collapsed sections down the left rail of which the first carries a row marked by a filled blue square, an empty chart canvas holding a faint line illustration above two centred lines of text, and the presenter's circular webcam overlay at the lower left.
source_value.end_state: media/state-05.png at 11s: the same insight builder in the same configuration, the same chart-type icon still boxed, the same left-rail rows, the same empty-canvas illustration and text; only the presenter's webcam overlay shows a different pose.
source_value.continuity: Continuous inside one page: no navigation, dialog, menu, panel change or scroll occurs. All five retained stills are the same product view, and every pixel that differs by more than 30/255 between any pair of them falls inside the webcam overlay rectangle x 5-33, y 105-138; the pairwise whole-frame mean absolute difference between the stills ranges from 0.40/255 (state-01 vs state-03) to 1.97/255 (state-04 vs state-05).
source_value.feedback: Selection feedback here is static and persistent rather than animated: the first of the four chart-type icons keeps a filled light-lavender background and the first left-rail section keeps a row marked with a filled blue square, both present unchanged in all five retained stills.
source_value.reduced_motion_equivalent: Nothing in this asset is carried by motion. The product state in media/state-05.png is the same state already shown in media/state-01.png, so a reader who never plays the recording loses no product information.
